method: Normal playing screenshot viewed at original 1920x1080; all fourteen screenshots additionally viewed on four labeled 2x2 sheets at 960x540 per original. Originals unchanged.
scope: Only archived connected/playing/paused/focus/disconnect/reconnect/second-client states; not a claim that all RPG screens were captured by this run.
